command: cd /workspace && P=hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/fs/sftp/SFTPFileSystem.java && git add $P && git diff --cached -- $P > requirement_patches/sftp-close-reentrancy.diff && test -s requirement_patches/sftp-close-reentrancy.diff; echo "diff-size:$?"; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do git commit -q -m "impl: sftp-close-reentrancy" -- $P && { echo COMMITTED; break; } || sleep $((3+RANDOM%6)); done
